Like many people on this list, I too purchased the $12.99 bundle to eliminate ads and was told it only eliminates the “forced” ads on the Home Screen.  Thirdly, when I got up into the level 30’s I started seeing count limit rear its ugly head.  So if you can’t complete the level within 2 spot filled instances, you get an auto count limit that shuts down the level; even if you have correct busses, open spaces and busses filling.  Lastly, after an initial query that was responded to, the support team stopped responding. Typical money grab app with no thought given to the consumer.  I will be deleting it immediately following this review

author: Sarah Tonin’s Takes
title: Really fun at first
content:
I’ll miss this game! I enjoyed the first 51 levels and was planning to buy the ‘ads free’ option, but then I hit the timers. The game is not fun with the pressure of the bright red flashing timer. I have to play each level repeatedly or would have to purchase power-ups to continue. 

Paying to advance in levels is no longer a game; it’s a racket. I was fine with watching ads to unlock extra parking spaces, but the game is no fun when you have to either use power-ups to complete each level (that’s not a puzzle anymore) or play the entire time with laser focus and high stress. No thanks. 

Thanks for the fun fifty-level game! Hopefully I’ll find a similar fun puzzle game that has more than 50 levels.
